name: Inner Mongolia Furui Medical Science Co., Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia Furui Medical Science Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of pharmaceutical drugs in China and internationally. The company also engages in the research and development and sales of diagnostic equipment and related medical services. It offers FibroScan series of liver fibrosis diagnostic instruments; FibroMeter series of blood test analysis tools for evaluating chronic liver disease; and FibroView data management software. It provides digital health management services; compound turtle shell softening liver tablets; and prescription drugs.
